metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.4 · 2004 · Private Eye Vares
metas.description: On the trail of a woman, Vares finds himself caught up with underworld characters who are on the trail of hidden millions.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.2 · 2007 · V2: Dead Angel

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.2 · 2011 · Garter Snake
metas.description: Vares gets a client who needs private investigations. Despite the beautiful wife, Vares smells a rat.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.4 · 2011 · The Girls of April
metas.description: Tough Finnish detective Jussi Vares gets hired by a friend at a newspaper to investigate a 15 year old mystery regarding the disappearance of 3 girls.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.0 · 2011 · The Kiss of Evil
metas.description: A young student is found stabbed, and her family hires Vares to investigate the case.

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.8 · 2012 · Vares: The Path of the Righteous Men
metas.description: Jussi Vares goes in a small town to investigate a murder of young girl. This little goodloving town isn't as pure as it seems.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.2 · 2012 · Vares: Tango of Darkness
metas.description: The tango king Harry Koivikko was found dead six years ago in a sleaze bag motel, with a knife is his back. The biggest manhunt in the county faded away without results.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 5.0 · 2012 · Vares: Gambling Chip
metas.description: Vares falls in love with a beautiful brunette - only to lose her in a horrible way. After dating Sole a few weeks, her body is found in a bird-watching tower.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 5.3 · 2015 · Vares: The Sheriff
metas.description: Private Eye Jussi Vares finds two dead bodies in a remote house. A year later, Vares is hired to investigate the case. Vares gets dangerously close to the "Council" - a secret gentlemen's club, the head of which is "The Sheriff". ...

metas.name: 10 · ★ 3.6 · 2024 · Vares X
metas.description: Vares gets a desperate phone call from his friend Kyypakkaus, who needs rescuing. While Vares rescues his friend, the daughter of a private detective's stepfamily is kidnapped. Vares is forced to play for higher stakes than ever before. Events become intertwined with a mysterious sex cult and an underworld showdown. Who can Jussi Vares finally save?
